commands: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project JustTones.xcodeproj -scheme JustTones -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' test
fileChanges: JustTones/ContentView.swift — reorganize the primary tone stack, introduce the header state presentation, consolidate sound controls, preserve accessible order/labels, and expose stable UI identifiers needed by tests.
JustTones/Localizable.xcstrings — localize every new or changed visible and accessibility string, including state labels and the output-level value-bearing label.
JustTonesUITests/JustTonesUITests.swift — primary-surface UI coverage for JT-TEST-053 through JT-TEST-058, if the existing target source layout is available.
JustTonesTests/JustTonesTests.swift and/or focused playback-host tests — only the deterministic state assertions necessary to make UI-state presentation testable.
notes: No audio-engine, audio-session, background-mode, microphone, network, account, analytics, Watch, or secondary-destination persistent-bar change is authorized by SP-028. The persistent-bar work belongs to SP-029.
scope: Replace the passive Grid in JustTones/ContentView.swift with a header-owned textual playback-state badge alongside the existing profile, pitch, and locale-formatted frequency; map Stopped, Starting, Playing, Stopping when exposed, and Unavailable to truthful host lifecycle presentation.

Retain Previous, prominent Play/Stop, and Next as the only transport; preserve silent stopped pitch selection, click-free active pitch transitions, explicit safety review, and stop-before-profile-change behavior.

Make the menu timbre picker and a single labeled output slider the only canonical timbre/level presentations. The slider label/value must include the current localized percentage and the existing non-SPL explanatory text; remove the separate LabeledContent value and passive summary duplicates.
Keep Profiles and Settings as secondary destinations; do not move authoring, tuning-system, import/export, or other administration into the primary stack.

Add/extend JustTones UI coverage for canonical locations, absent duplicate grid, silent selection while stopped, direct active navigation, profile-change stop behavior, and controls visible during playback. Add deterministic lifecycle coverage only if a state presentation cannot be reliably observed through UI automation.
summary: Implement the EP-018 iPhone primary-screen hierarchy by replacing duplicate passive status with one truthful tone header, retaining direct transport and controls, and adding focused UI/state coverage without changing the qualified audio engine or starting audio implicitly.
title: SP-028 iPhone primary tone surface plan
verificationCriteria: JT-TEST-053 through JT-TEST-058 demonstrate the canonical iPhone surface, silent stopped selection, direct active pitch transitions, ordered previous/next, safe profile changes, and persistent primary controls.

Manual inspection at accessibility text sizes, with VoiceOver, and with localized text verifies the specified ordering, textual state, non-clipping layout, and locale-aware frequency/percentage presentation.
